name: Win Loop 8
description: Card #[N] of 33. Win Loop, hi Miya Maker — a 33-card journey by Dragonfluss aka Kardy. A glitch in the system that kept winning. A muse caught in fragments: layered collage, bright chaos, digital underground. Miyazaki canvases inside a circuit. Each card holds its own myth. Together they form the only collection that exists. All prior work, gone. This is what remained.
